## Overview

The script processes records from the Credential_Non_Dup table (derived in `01c-credential-analysis.R`) to ensure that every apprenticeship record has a valid 4-digit and 2-digit CIP code. It follows a hierarchical "fallback" matching strategy, where the most specific match (6-digit) is attempted first, followed by broader matches if data is missing.

## Methodology Overview

### Methods

APPSO records from the STP credential (credential_non_dup) table are isolated for processing.  Light pre-processing was done on the STP Credential CIP column, PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP.  Before matching, the PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP strings are cleaned to correct common formatting inconsistencies:

- Length-6 Padding: If a CIP is 6 characters and the second character is not a period (e.g., 123456), a trailing 0 is appended.
- Leading Zeros: If a CIP is still only 6 characters, a leading 0 is prepended to ensure a standardized length.

The script attempts to populate STP_CIP_CODE_4 and STP_CIP_CODE_2 using the following priority:

- Exact 6-Digit Match: Joins directly on the normalized PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP against the Infoware 6-digit table.
- 5-Character Fallback: For records still missing a code, the script joins on the first 5 characters of the CIP string.
- General Program Rule: Applies a "General" designation (mapping 00 to 01) for specific program prefixes (e.g., 11.00, 14.00, 52.00).
- 2-Digit Fallback: A final attempt to map at least the 2-digit CIP family based on the first two characters of the institutional CIP.

Once codes are assigned, the script joins descriptive names for both 4-digit and 2-digit codes.  Any record that fails all matching steps and lacks a 4-digit name is explicitly labeled as "Invalid 4-digit CIP".  Administrative placeholders are removed such as (Unspecified) from the PSI_PROGRAM_CODE column.

### Technical Notes

The script uses `sql("CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255))")` to initialize columns. This is necessary because dbplyr may default a plain NA to an INT type in SQL Server, which causes type-mismatch errors during subsequent character joins or updates.

## Key Output Tables

The APPSO program matching process generates the following data tables.

### Table: Credential_Non_Dup_APPSO_IDs

The finalized dataset containing student IDs linked to their standardized CIP codes and descriptive names.

<ul class="list-variable-names">
  <li>ID (Number): Unique primary key for the student record within the STP dataset.</li>
  <li>PSI_CODE (String): Administrative code identifying the post-secondary institution.</li>
  <li>PSI_PROGRAM_CODE (String): Internal code assigned by the institution to the specific program of study.</li>
  <li>PSI_CREDENTIAL_PROGRAM_DESCRIPTION (String): Descriptive name of the program as provided by the institution.</li>
  <li>PSI_CREDENTIAL_CIP (String): The raw, unstandardized CIP code submitted by the institution.</li>
  <li>PSI_AWARD_SCHOOL_YEAR (String): The academic school year in which the credential was awarded (e.g., "2022/2023").</li>
  <li>OUTCOMES_CRED (String): An acronym identifying the survey cohort, specifically set to "APPSO" for apprenticeship outcomes.</li>
  <li>FINAL_CIP_CODE_4 (String): The cleaned, standardized and matched 4-digit CIP code assigned to the record.</li>
  <li>FINAL_CIP_CODE_4_NAME (String): The official descriptive name associated with the standardized 4-digit CIP code.</li>
  <li>FINAL_CIP_CODE_2 (String): The cleaned, standardized and matched 2-digit CIP family code.</li>
  <li>FINAL_CIP_CODE_2_NAME (String): The official descriptive name for the 2-digit CIP family (e.g., "Engineering").</li>
</ul>
